# The deferred-first-document dock arm reads ownership mid-swap

## Context

Grace captured this as a defect-note on 2026-10-10 at 14:03Z. `DockOperationsNL` › "a deferred first document cannot poison the SharedWorker mount or later edge resizes" failed 2 of 10 runs on `dev` `6c1e478f9d`, with worker ownership holding two `edge-zone` root shells for `root`: one mounted, one `mounted: false`.

I reproduced it independently on `dev` `453915f332`. A local probe, never committed, re-read ownership every 250 ms for up to 5 s after the arm's own read:

- Of 70 runs, 6 read two shells. In each of the 6, the bootstrap shell (`neo-container-1`, mounted) sat beside the real document's shell (`neo-container-3`, `mounted: false`), and `verifyComponentConsistency` read `consistent: false`.
- All 6 settled by the next 250 ms tick, leaving one shell: the real one, mounted. A consistency read after the settle returned `true`, and the arm's later edge-resize steps passed.

## The Problem

The arm reads ownership and consistency once, after two gates. Both gates pass before the projection's shell swap finishes. The worker commits the deferred document (five items) first, and at that moment the DOM still holds exactly one root shell, the bootstrap one. About 9% of runs read in that window and fail, even though the engine settles a moment later.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockOperationsNL.spec.mjs`, in that arm: a topology poll and a DOM count gate, then a single `findInstances({parentId})` plus `verifyComponentConsistency` read.
- The fixture is `test/playwright/component/apps/dock-first-mount/app.mjs`: a `DeferredDockWorkspace` with a bootstrap document, whose real document commits before the first mount.
- **Design authority:** #17888, the defect this arm guards, defines the poison as permanent: "the workspace comes up wrong and **stays wrong** … the old shell never left … **Not self-healing**". A swap that completes within 250 ms is not that defect.

## The Fix

The fix is test-only. Poll worker ownership, bounded at about 5 s, until it holds exactly one mounted `edge-zone` root shell for `root`, and only then read `verifyComponentConsistency`. A second shell that never leaves, #17888's poison, still fails the arm when the poll times out. No engine change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The arm reads consistency only after worker ownership holds one mounted root shell. The wait is bounded, so a shell that never leaves still fails it.
- [ ] The arm passes 40/40 alone under `--repeat-each=40` at the PR head. The same loop read 6 of 70 runs mid-swap on `dev`.

## Out of Scope

The engine's order of commit before projection. It settles within 250 ms, and the arm's guarantee does not need it changed.

## Related

- #17888 / #17898: the poison this arm guards.
- #14800: the v13.2 dock polish.
